verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API with REST endpoints such as POST /v1/document_sets and GET /v1/document_sets/{id}/forms, and it publishes an llms.txt index of markdown docs. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent spec: probes of common OpenAPI paths on handbooks.clerky.com all returned 404. The per-form json_schema is a runtime payload, not an API specification. Confidence is medium because the developers.clerky.com host was not probed for a spec file.
